steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to Gitea as username 'admin' with password exactly the text '{{env:APP_PASSWORD}}' (type it literally as that placeholder text; it is filled in when typed). Use the sign-in page at http://127.0.0.1:8095/user/login. Verify you are signed in (e.g. the admin user appears / dashboard loads) and report what you see.

02-open: Go to the repository bench/bench-repo at http://127.0.0.1:8095/bench/bench-repo and open its Issues tab (filter to open issues). List the titles of all OPEN issues whose title starts with 'Seed:' exactly as displayed on the page. Report each title verbatim, one per line, and note how many there are. Do not modify anything.

03-create: In the repository bench/bench-repo, create a new issue with title exactly '{{runid}} Bench Issue' and a description (markdown text area) that includes the text '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Bench issue created for run {{runid}}.'). Submit the issue. Then report the issue's number as displayed (Gitea shows it as #<number>), its title, and the URL of the new issue page. Do not set labels, assignee or milestone yet.

04-add: On the issue page {{03-create.url}} (issue titled '{{runid}} Bench Issue'), use the Labels picker in the issue's sidebar to add exactly the two labels 'bug' and 'priority-high' (and no others). Make sure the app applies them and the issue page shows the labels 'bug' and 'priority-high' in the sidebar/labels area. Report exactly which labels are shown on the issue after applying.

05-open: On the issue page {{03-create.url}} (issue titled '{{runid}} Bench Issue'), use the Assignees picker in the issue's sidebar to assign the issue to the user 'bench-assignee'. Make sure the app applies it and the issue page shows 'bench-assignee' as the assignee in the sidebar (not merely ticked in the open menu). Note: the same commit-on-close behaviour may apply — after clicking the assignee item in the open menu, click elsewhere (e.g. the h1 issue title) to close/commit the picker. Verify with a full page reload and report exactly what assignee is shown on the issue.
